facts.fact: MBC reports the Secretary to the President and Cabinet presented certificates on 7 November 2023 to 112 civil servants who completed a six-month digital skills training at the Malawi School of Government, organised by the Malawi Government with the Tony Blair Institute; about 180 enrolled.
facts.system: Digital Skills Training, Malawi School of Government

MWI.note: Training was for civil servants only.
No statement bearing on this question.
